experiment: P7 contiguous-KV FA3 selector with a Triton row-gather kernel (replaces torch index_select)
offline: kernel compiled for sm_90 with Triton 3.9.0 (compile_gk.py): coalesced b64 loads/stores, no shared memory
evidence_basis: P4/P5/P6: contiguous FA3 selected and applied 3x (FA3 -3.5..-3.8% incl. gather) on first turn full ctx 32768/65536; index_select gather ~110 us for both caches at 81,920 rows (0.38 TB/s); 753-token full shapes ~15 us faster before the gather
affected_rule: full-layer loads whose key is P7_SELECTed and reported P7_USE at runtime

gates.selection: >=3% faster in prepare incl. gather, rel-L2 < 1e-2 vs paged output
gates.retention: single run is not enough: affected shapes normalized >= 1.02 vs each of same-night P1/P2/P3 AND a confirming run in a later authorized window
